name: web-sidebar-roster
description: With no agent running, the web UI still gets koordinator first in New Session, the gems that ran here (offline, with when), the last network roster seen, and the workspace picker's folders

steps.label: an engine with no agent running

steps.description: throwaway HOME, a vault for sapphire and a saved roster, then ask the engine
steps.command: R=$(pwd); H=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-roster.XXXXXX"); mkdir -p "$H/.kollab" "$H/ws"; cd "$H/ws" && HOME="$H" KOLLAB_NO_KEYRING=1 "$R/.venv/bin/python" "$R/tests/tmux/lib/web_sidebar_roster.py"; rm -rf "$H"

steps.description: New Session offers koordinator first while this folder runs none
the gem list knows sapphire ran here
the sidebar lists sapphire as offline
the last roster seen shows with no agent here on the network
the workspace picker gets the engine folder and its subfolders
